points.case_title: The service suspends your account after inactivity for a certain or uncertain time
points.quote_text:
SurveyMonkey may terminate your account and delete any Content contained in it if there is no account activity (such as a log in event or payment) for over 12 months.
However, we will attempt to warn you by email before terminating your account to provide you with an opportunity to log in to your account so that it remains active.
